name: Pixel Mono
description: Pixel-art format in a strict 4-color handheld palette: every layer quantized to four greens with ordered dithering for light and sky, soft parallax blur, a minimal pixel banner and an RPG dialog box. Calm, nostalgic, very readable.
prompt_hint: Write 5-9 scenes (3-5 s each). Every scene has visual.type "pixel" with visual.pixel: {set, props?, character?, banner?, one of popup|counter|checklist?, speaker?}. Sets: room, street, desert, factory, gallery, temple, forest, lab, space. Props: monitor, laptop, phone, door, window, lamp, lantern, crate, plant, coin, block, trophy, hourglass, sign, chest, item, heart, key, scroll, robot (max 6, one may be big). The hook scene uses banner.big; other scenes use a short boxed banner (2-4 words) with one accent word. The narration is typed into the RPG dialog box at the bottom, so keep sentences short. Add character only when the user asks for one. Never use emoji.
